item.title: Girls basketball: Downingtown West thumps West Chester East to defend Ches-Mont title
item.description: WEST CHESTER — The Downingtown West girls basketball team has postseason goals of winning a district and state title this season, but goal number one was to defend its Ches-Mont League championship. They completed the first one in dominating fashion as they held West Chester East to just six total field goals in leading from start to finish to roll to a 50-26 victory. item.title: College women’s basketball: West Chester drops fourth straight as postseason hopes falter
item.description: Following Wednesday’s 58-52 setback to visiting Bloomsburg, WCU has dropped four straight, six of its last seven, and will now have to fight down the stretch just to qualify for the postseason.

item.title: Defensive pressure spurs West Chester to lopsided win over Bloomsburg
item.description: Looking for a surge at the end of the regular season, the West Chester men kicked off its stretch run Wednesday with a dominating wire-to-wire 88-59 basketball triumph over Bloomsburg at Hollinger Field House.

item.title: In historic fashion, West Chester East wrestlers edge Rustin
item.description: With a couple key wins, and of course a little bit of controversy, East topped Rustin, 33-25. It was the first time, ever, East has beaten Rustin and Henderson in the same season, for the unofficial West Chester championship. It was also East’s first win over Rustin since 2020.
